title: RISK: soft token slot uses WP11_PROTO_PIV as placeholder protocol
description: wp11_pkcs11.c:1116: g_slots[0].proto = WP11_PROTO_PIV with comment 'placeholder; soft token doesn't use a protocol'. Any contributor who iterates g_slots[] and branches on proto (a natural thing to do when adding PIV-specific features) will misidentify the soft token as a PIV device. The WP11_PROTO_FLASH value already exists as a distinct protocol type; there is no WP11_PROTO_SOFT or WP11_PROTO_NONE. Fix: add WP11_PROTO_SOFT = 0 to the wp11_proto_t enum in wp11_token_db.h (value 0 ensures zero-init works correctly), update g_slots[0].proto to use it, and add a static_assert or comment noting that proto == WP11_PROTO_SOFT is the soft-token discriminant. This prevents the PIV APDU path from ever being accidentally invoked for the soft token.
